episodes.title: It Takes Two
episodes.summary: Twelve All Stars arrive to compete for $100,000 and a chance to become the first inductee into RuPaul's Drag Race Hall of Fame.

episodes.title: RuPaul's Gaff-In
episodes.summary: The queens find themselves battling for laughs while impersonating their favorite celebrities on "RuPaul's Gaff-In" with Vicki Lawrence's "Mama".

episodes.title: Queens Behaving Badly
episodes.summary: The queens hit the streets of Hollywood to prank unsuspecting passers-by.

episodes.title: All Star Girl Groups
episodes.summary: Legendary children Kady Z, Jillian Hervey and Kelly Osbourne join the queens to form All Star girl groups in a battle of the divas for the fiercest set.

episodes.title: Dynamic Drag Duos
episodes.summary: The final four assume super hero and super foe alter egos and go to epic heights to vanquish their nemesis.

episodes.title: The Grand Finale
episodes.summary: For the final challenge, RuPaul sends her All Stars on a junket that culminates with a stand-up routine at L.A.'s Comedy Store.

episodes.title: All Star Talent Show Extravaganza
episodes.summary: Ten Queens return to compete for $100,000 and a place in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. The first test is to compete in a drag talent show. With guest judge Raven-Symoné.

episodes.title: All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.summary: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show and burn rubber in a latex runway. With guest judge Ross Mathews.

episodes.title: HERstory of the World
episodes.summary: The queens are challenged to perform in a lip-syncing dance number inspired by the legendary historical women. Fashion designer Jeremy Scott guest judges.

episodes.title: Drag Movie Shequels
episodes.summary: The queens' acting chops are tested in parody movie sequels of RuPaul's favorite movies. Pussycat Doll Nicole Scherzinger guest judges.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Queens
episodes.summary: The queens must perform a live stand-up comedy act in front of an audience of judgmental drag queens. Ross Mathews returns to guest judge.

episodes.title: Drag Fish Tank
episodes.summary: The Queens create an item and a commercial that represents their brand.

episodes.title: Family That Drags Together
episodes.summary: The queens must makeover family members and vogue the house down. Aubrey Plaza (Parks and Recreation) guest judges.

episodes.title: All Stars Supergroup
episodes.summary: The Queens slay the top four as the competition gets harder and a winner is crowned.

episodes.title: All-Star Variety Show
episodes.summary: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars 3 Episode 1 is here with all of your favorite queens as they fight for the crown and a chance at a spot in RuPaul's Drag Race Hall of Fame.

episodes.title: Divas Lip Sync Live
episodes.summary: The remaining All Stars give a gag-worthy performance as classic songstress divas on the main stage, then hit the runway - category is RuDemption Realness.

episodes.title: The B*tchelor
episodes.summary: The remaining all stars compete in a mock-reality show to chase the man of their dreams, Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman. On the runway, the girls show off their heads in a hair-on-hair-on-hair extravaganza.

episodes.title: All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.summary: After Milk is eliminated, the dolls ramp up their improv skills for an All Stars Snatch Game, complete with all out Flower Power runway on the Main Stage.

episodes.title: Pop Art Ball
episodes.summary: The remains queens from RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars 3 compete in the Pop Art Ball featuring staples from Andy Warhol's litany of art, then hit the runway with Soup Can Realness and Studio 54 Disco Looks!

episodes.title: Handmaids to Kitty Girls
episodes.summary: The workroom is starting to feel a little empty after last week's elimination. Are the remaining queens prepared for what Mama Ru is about to tell them?

episodes.title: My Best Squirrelfriend's Dragsmaids Wedding Trip
episodes.summary: The queens' acting chops are put to the test in a girl comedy blockbuster scene; House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi (D-Calif.) stops by the workroom; Chris Colfer and Garcelle Beauvais guest judge.

episodes.title: A Jury of Their Queers
episodes.summary: The final four perform in a huge video endeavor for RuPaul's 'Kitty Girl'. Then, the final four sit with the jury, comprising of all of the eliminated queens and one is chosen as the winner of RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars 3.

episodes.title: All Star Super Queen Variety Show
episodes.summary: 10 All Stars compete for $100,000 and a place in the Drag Race Hall of Fame! Their first challenge is a salute to LGBTQ troops in an All Star-Spangled Variety Show! Extra special guest judge: Jenifer Lewis.

episodes.title: Super Girl Groups, Henny
episodes.summary: The All Stars audition for a new supergroup, "Henny!" featuring Drag Race legend, Stacy Layne Matthews. Extra special guest judges Kacey Musgraves and Ciara.

episodes.title: Snatch Game Of Love
episodes.summary: Everyone's favorite game show is back, but this time with a romantic twist! As the All Stars impersonate celebrities to win the hearts of hunky bachelors. Extra special guest judges: Olympian, Gus Kenworthy and Keiynan Lonsdale ("Love Simon").

episodes.title: Jersey Justice
episodes.summary: In a salute to all things Jersey, the All Stars plead their cases before "Judge" Michelle Visage in an unscripted courtroom parody. Extra special guest judges: Zoe Kravitz and comedian Erica Ash.

episodes.title: Roast In Peace
episodes.summary: The All Stars write and perform a "Rulogy" for Lady Bunny in a comedy roast before a live audience… and an open casket! Extra special guest judges: SNL's Cecily Strong and Yvette Nicole Brown.

episodes.title: LaLaPaRuZa
episodes.summary: For the first time in Drag Race Herstory, all of the eliminated All Stars get a chance to return to the competition. But first they have to send home a competing All Star in a shocking midseason lip sync smackdown.

episodes.title: Queens Of Clubs
episodes.summary: The All Stars are challenged to design and host their own VIP club nights. Extra special guest judges: Rita Ora and NYC Nightlife legend Susanne Bartsch.

episodes.title: RuPaul's Best Judy's Race
episodes.summary: The All Stars pay tribute to the LGBTQ legend, Judy Garland, as they transform their best friends into members of their own drag family! Extra special guest judges Francis Bean Cobain and Ellen Pompeo.

episodes.title: Sex And The Kitty, Girl 3
episodes.summary: The All Stars star in a movie sequel centered on the sex lives of NYC singles and the actresses who play them. Extra special guest judges: Designer Jason Wu and Felicity Huffman.

episodes.title: Super Queen Grand Finale
episodes.summary: To win a place in Drag Race Hall of Fame, the final 4 queens must write and perform a verse for RuPaul's song "Super Queen," and appear on the "What's the T" podcast with RuPaul and Michelle Visage. Guest appearances by past winners Chad Michaels, Alaska, and Trixie Mattel. Extra special guest judges: Todrick Hall, Carson Kressley and Ross Mathews.

episodes.title: All Star Variety Extravaganza
episodes.summary: The Season 5 All Stars make their werkroom entrances, extra special guest judge Ricky Martin gives a lesson in bilingual shade, and a new elimination twist is Ruvealed.

episodes.title: I'm In Love!
episodes.summary: The All Stars perform girl-group songs about their celebrity crushes and strut the runway in Love the Skin You're In lewks, and Tessa Thompson and Madison Beer guest judge.

episodes.title: Get A Room!
episodes.summary: The All Stars design their own boutique hotel suite experiences and show off three-in-one lewks on the runway, and Nicole Byer and Martyn Lawrence Bullard guest judge.

episodes.title: SheMZ
episodes.summary: The All Stars improv their way through celebrity scandals on a TMZ-inspired tabloid reality series and then walk the runway in camo couture, and Sarah Hyland guest judges.

episodes.title: Snatch Game Of Love
episodes.summary: Guest judges Tommy Dorfman and Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman join the All Stars for a dating-themed version of Snatch Game, and the category on the runway is Prom Queen Fantasy.

episodes.title: The Charles Family Backyard Ball
episodes.summary: For the barbecue-themed Charles Family Backyard Ball, the All Stars design runway lewks using materials that can be found in a yard, and Bebe Rexha guest judges.

episodes.title: Stand-Up Smackdown
episodes.summary: The All Stars perform stand-up sets for guest judges Sam Richardson and Jane Krakowski at RuPaul's Shady Shack, and the category on the runway is Freak Out.

episodes.title: Clap Back!
episodes.summary: Before the next All Star is inducted into the Drag Race Hall of Fame, the eliminated queens return, and the Top Three girls write and perform verses of RuPaul's "Clap Back!"

episodes.title: All Star Variety Extravaganza
episodes.summary: The Queens of All Stars 6 are back to compete for a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. To kick off the competition, the dolls showcase their best talents on the Main Stage. Plus, the iconic Miss Piggy pops by to prove that reading IS fundamental.

episodes.title: The Blue Ball
episodes.summary: The All Stars storm the runway in their bold and blue-tiful best – in the Blue Ball! Guest Judge Big Freedia helps decide whose design will earn a blue ribbon.

episodes.title: Side Hustles
episodes.summary: Even the best queen needs a side hustle, so the All Stars must create commercials to sell their services. Tia Mowry joins as guest judge.

episodes.title: Halftime Headliners
episodes.summary: Fireworks fly as the All Stars celebrate and impersonate their favorite divas in an epic halftime show. Jamal Sims whips the dolls into shape as guest choreographer and judge.

episodes.title: Pink Table Talk
episodes.summary: The All Stars serve up piping hot tea as hosts of an up close and personal talk show: Pink Table Talk. Guest Judge Aisha Tyler stops by to join the kiki.

episodes.title: Rumerican Horror Story: Coven Girls
episodes.summary: Who is the baddest witch of all? Find out as the All Stars showcase their acting chops in this spooky spoof. Superstar Angela Bassett offers bewitching advice, and Guest Judge Emma Roberts stops by to cast a spell of her own.

episodes.title: Show Up Queen
episodes.summary: Drag and activism come together as the All Stars record and perform an inspiring anthem: "Show Up Queen!" Designer extraordinaire Zaldy brings his eye for fashion to the judging panel.

episodes.title: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.summary: The All Stars serve up their best celebrity impressions in a dating show version of the Snatch Game. Who's getting lucky? Guest judges Fortune Feimster and Cheyenne Jackson search for their perfect snatch match.

episodes.title: Drag Tots
episodes.summary: The All Stars turn themselves into magical characters fit for the hit animated series, Drag Tots. Guest Judge Charli XCX stops by for this fierce foray into fantasy and fun.

episodes.title: Rudemption Lip-Sync Smackdown
episodes.summary: The eliminated queens are back to compete in an epic Lip Sync Smackdown and a chance to return to the competition.

episodes.title: The Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve and Talent Monologues
episodes.summary: The All Stars take the stage to share hilarious and heartwarming true stories in a performance challenge that decides who makes it to the Grand Finale! Actors Jermaine Fowler and Alec Mapa coach the queens; writer/director Justin Simien joins the judges' panel.

episodes.title: This is Our Country
episodes.summary: Who will take home the crown? A spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame is at stake as the finalists write, record, and perform verses to RuPaul's new song This is Our Country, featuring country music legend Tanya Tucker.

episodes.title: Legends
episodes.summary: Eight legendary RuPaul's Drag Race winners have returned to battle for the title of "Queen of All Queens." After a raucous reading challenge and an epic runway session with supermodel Naomi Campbell, our queens must put together a show-stopping performance of RuPaul's song "Legends." Special Guest Judge Cameron Diaz brings her star power to the Drag Race panel.

episodes.title: Snatch Game
episodes.summary: For the first time in Drag Race herstory, the crowned queens must perform two iconic celebrity impersonations in a Snatch Game Double-Header! International style icon Daphne Guiness joins the judges' panel.

episodes.title: The Realness of Fortune Ball
episodes.summary: The legendary queens put their spin on the classic Drag Race ball challenge, serving 3 looks each in the "Realness of Fortune" Ball. Vanna White is in the house to make sure things are letter-perfect, and actress Kirby Howell-Baptiste graces the judges' panel.

episodes.title: Fairytale Justice
episodes.summary: All rise! The legends are telling tall tales in court as they bring their best storybook characters to the witness stand in this twisted improv challenge. Drag Race veteran Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman is back to testify on the judges' panel.

episodes.title: Dragulation Speeches
episodes.summary: The queens deliver inspiring and irreverent commencement speeches for draguates around the world. Nikki Glaser shares her comedic expertise and helps Mama Ru pick this week's Valedictorian.

episodes.title: Total Ru-quest Live
episodes.summary: The queens live out their Y2K girl group fantasies on a dragtastic tribute to TRL! And on the runway, category is: Night of 1,000 Dolly Partons. Pop star Tove Lo joins the judges' panel.

episodes.title: Legendary Legend Looks
episodes.summary: Fashion Icon and Supermodel of the World, Rupaul, challenges the crowned queens to use their divine design skills to transform eight of her legendary looks. Iconic and effervescent designer Betsey Johnson spices up the judges' panel.

episodes.title: Santa's School for Girls
episodes.summary: Ho ho ho! The queens make the yuletide gayer as they star in the twisted new holiday cult classic, "Santa's School for Girls." Acclaimed film director Janicza Bravo brings her expertise to set, and reviews the queens' performances on the judges panel.

episodes.title: Dance Like Drag Queen
episodes.summary: The queens try to break the internet by creating an original dance video challenge. On the runway, category is: What Lies Beneath. Ben Platt lends his voice to the judges' panel.

episodes.title: The Kennedy Davenport Centre Honors Hall of Shade
episodes.summary: The queens take the stage to roast each other at the first-ever Kennedy Davenport Center "Hall of Shade" Honors. Pulitzer prize-winning journalist, Ronan Farrow, joins the esteemed judges' panel.

episodes.title: Drag Race Gives Back Variety Extravaganza
episodes.summary: The crowned queens give 'til it hurts, as they star in a charity talent show extravaganza! But first, they each join RuPaul and Michelle Visage for an intimate tic-tac chit-chat! Super-hot actress and comedian Hannah Einbinder joins the judges' panel.

episodes.title: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza Smackdown
episodes.summary: It's a lip sync battle royale, as the crowned queens take the stage for the most epic Lip Sync LalaPaRuza in Drag Race herstory. And in the end, one legend will be crowned Queen of All Queens.

episodes.title: The Fame Games
episodes.summary: Twelve Drag Race All Stars return for a second chance at the crown and a cash prize of $200,000. And this season, there are two ways to win! After a sickening fashion show mini-challenge, the queens thrill iconic guest judge Idina Menzel.

episodes.title: "It's RDR Live!"
episodes.summary: "Live from Tuckahoe... it's RDR Live!" The All Stars are challenged to serve up laughs in a hilarious Drag Race send-up of the iconic sketch comedy show.

episodes.title: The Supermarket Ball
episodes.summary: The All Stars storm the runway - and the grocery aisle - transforming everyday supermarket items into supermodel-worthy fashions! Guest judge Jojo Siwa is having a ball as she checks out the parade of 30 gag-worthy garments.

episodes.title: Screen Queens
episodes.summary: The Golden Age of Television gets even sparklier, as the All Stars create and star in their own sickening scripted TV series trailers, directed by Emmy® Award winner Michelle Visage.

episodes.title: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.summary: Love is in the air as the queens serve up their flirtiest celebrity impersonations for guest judges Bowen Yang and Matt Rogers in the romantic and raucous "Snatch Game of Love."

episodes.title: JOAN: The Unauthorized Rusical
episodes.summary: The All Stars channel Hollywood royalty, singing and dancing in "JOAN: The Unauthorized Rusical," celebrating "Mommie Dearest" herself, Joan Crawford!

episodes.title: Forensic Queens
episodes.summary: The Queens' improv talents are on full display, as they star in a twisted true-crime show, examining the mystery, "Wha-Ha-Happened to Lil' Poundcake."

episodes.title: You're A Winner, Baby!
episodes.summary: RuPaul challenges the queens to create looks worthy of the Drag Race Hall of Fame, inspired by past All Stars champions. Drag Race legends Raven and Shannel bring some style guidance to the workroom.

episodes.title: Carson Kressley, This is Your Gay Life
episodes.summary: The All Stars heat things up to roast beloved judge Carson Kressley in front of a live audience, including a very extra-special surprise guest queen & judge! Michelle Visage and comedian Alec Mapa coach the queens.

episodes.title: The Letter "L"
episodes.summary: Celebrating the L in LGBTQIA+ , the queens share the miracle of drag with new lesbian sisters, transforming the fabulous queer women into fabulous drag queens.

episodes.title: The Fame Games Variety Extravaganza
episodes.summary: They're back! The eliminated queens return to the workroom and read each other to filth before showing off their charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent one last time in the Fame Games Variety Extravaganza. Comedian Ego Nwodim joins the judges' panel.

episodes.title: Grand Finale
episodes.summary: The time has come... to crown two queens! First, Ru will announce who fans voted "Queen of the Fame Games!" Then, our top two finalists will battle for a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame, serving up performances to new original songs!

episodes.title: Drag Queens Save the World
episodes.summary: Eight All Stars return to compete to win $200,000 for their favorite charity, and a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. They serve up an epic performance of the anthem "Drag Queens Save the World," and Keke Palmer joins for this gagworthy premiere.

episodes.title: The Paint Ball
episodes.summary: The Queens present a total of 24 iconic looks on the runway - including hand-painted masterpieces created in the Werk Room - in the art-inspired Paint Ball. Oscar-nominated actor Stephanie Hsu joins the judges' panel to appraise the Queens' work.

episodes.title: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.summary: Romance is in the air as the Queens impersonate celebrities in the Snatch Game of Love. But when two All Stars want to play the same celeb, things get spicy! Meanwhile, a twist means that more badges are up for grabs! Pop superstar Anitta stops by.

episodes.title: Smokin' Hot Firefighter Makeover
episodes.summary: This week begins with fiery accusations, and when the Queens are tasked with transforming four sexy firefighters into hot pop stars, things really start to sizzle! Country music duo the Brothers Osborne join the judges panel and feel the heat.

episodes.title: Property Queens
episodes.summary: This week our All Stars' put their sales skills to the test, as they create raucous real estate commercials for some preposterous properties. Superstar Realtor Tracy Tutor and Comedian Alec Mapa stop by to assess what's on the market.

episodes.title: The National Drag Convention Roast
episodes.summary: While the Ruby Snippers cause icy vibes in the workroom, it's hotter than an oven on the main stage, as the Queens Roast each other to a crisp. Television icon Ruta Lee joins the panel to witness the hilarious jabs.

episodes.title: Meeting in the Ladies Room
episodes.summary: This week, the All-Stars get slap happy as they co-star with RuPaul in an acting challenge inspired by some of cinema's most classic catfights. Foxy actor Colton Haynes joins the judging panel to take in all the drama!

episodes.title: Make Your Own Kind of Rusic
episodes.summary: After hard feelings rock the workroom, Mama Ru challenges the dolls to create chart-topping looks inspired by her hit songs. Fashion icon Jeremy Scott joins the judge panel to decide which looks are bops and which are flops!

episodes.title: Rosemarie's Baby Shower: The Rusical
episodes.summary: This week, the All Stars dance with the devil in a spooky-ooky Rusical that leaves the judges shook! Dance music legend Kristine W joins the panel for a twisted good time.

episodes.title: Lip-Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown
episodes.summary: The competition is closer than ever, so when Ru announces that the Queens must Lip Sync for their badges this week, the All Stars go into Assassin mode to slay the stage! Who will be the last Queen standing?

episodes.title: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 1
episodes.summary: This week, Mama Ru drops a gag-worthy twist on the All-Stars... Before their final challenge of the season, the queens must cast a game-changing vote -- and it's anybody's crown to win!

episodes.title: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 2
episodes.summary: It's the crowning moment of the two-part Grand Finale, and all the Queens hit the stage for an unforgettable Variety Extravaganza! Three badges are up for grabs, and a new voting twist could change everything! In the end, only one queen can win.

episodes.title: Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner!
episodes.summary: The Tournament of All Stars kicks off with the first of three brackets. 6 queens enter the competition with their premiere challenge: deliver head-banging heavy metal realness in an 80s-inspired music video.

episodes.title: Murder on the Dance Floor
episodes.summary: It's Week 2 of the first bracket, and the queens must make the judges drop dead with their improv performances in the whodunit, "Murder on the Dance Floor." Emmy award winning actor and red carpet darling, Colman Domingo, guest judges.

episodes.title: Hoop Queens
episodes.summary: It's a buzzer beater to the Semi Finals for this first bracket of queens as they scramble to makeover collegiate basketball players. Meanwhile, the MVQ point system has the dolls calling, "foul," on their sisters. Kate Beckinsale joins the judges panel.

episodes.title: Eight Ball
episodes.summary: A new bracket of queens arrive in the werkroom where lines are drawn in the sand between competitors. A special delivery from Ru has queens creating dope looks from items found in giant 8-balls. Nightlife icon, Susanne Bartsch, returns to turn the party.

episodes.title: Rappin' Roast
episodes.summary: After a gaggy MVQ Points Ceremony, the queens are ready to create the ultimate diss track and battle each other in a Rappin' Roast. Supernova superstar Chappell Roan stops by to get a taste of the hot and spicy bars.

episodes.title: Starrbooty: The Rebooty
episodes.summary: With the semi-finals at stake, it's heroes versus villains, as the queens funk it up for a dyn-o-mite performance of the movie rusical, "Starrbooty: The Rebooty." Legendary producer and director, Adam Shankman, choreographs and guest judges.

episodes.title: Wicked Good
episodes.summary: The final bracket of 6 queens descend onto the Main Stage to stake their claim for the Drag Race Hall of Fame. Working in teams, the queens must create good and wicked witch looks for the runway. Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo enchant on the judges panel.

episodes.title: Stagecooch
episodes.summary: Coached by country superstar, Orville Peck, the queens divide into dueling country trios to perform honky tonk anthems at the first annual Stagecooch Festival. Drag Race choreographer extraordinaire Jamal Sims returns to the judges panel.

episodes.title: The Golden Bitchelor
episodes.summary: Things get real after a tense MVQ Points Ceremony. With 3 semi-final spots up for grabs, the queens vie for love and laughs in "The Golden Bitchelor" with "Fire Island" star Zane Phillips. Sitcom pro Mayan Lopez returns to help decide who will move on.

episodes.title: Tournament of All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.summary: The divine 9 Semi-Finalists return, and Mama Ru cranks up the heat by challenging them to serve their best celeb impersonations in the Snatch Game! Sarah Michelle Gellar slays the judges panel — and one All Star is sent home.

episodes.title: Tournament of All Stars Talent Invitational
episodes.summary: The 8 Semi-Finalists showcase their most gag-worthy talents in hopes of earning a spot in the finale. Superstar actress Devery Jacobs joins the judges— and one All Star is sent packing.

episodes.title: Tournament of All Stars Smackdown for the Crown
episodes.summary: One All Star returns to the competition, and everything is on the line as the final 8 queens lip sync for the crown! Which queen will snatch victory and be the newest face in the Drag Race Hall of Fame?

episodes.title: Break Dancin' 2: Electric Rugaloo
episodes.summary: The Tournament of All Stars kicks off as six queens from Bracket 1 break it down in an electrifying ‘80s-inspired performance. Guest judge La Toya Jackson is back – and the queens pay tribute in a dazzling "La Toyas R Us" runway.

episodes.title: Bar Queen Couture
episodes.summary: Tensions rise following the first MVQ Ceremony - and the queens are challenged to turn queer nightlife into couture using materials inspired by iconic gay bars. Oscar-nominated actress Kate Hudson joins the judges for this high-stakes showdown.

episodes.title: Shop Til U Drop
episodes.summary: With the scoreboard scrambled, the Bracket 1 queens transform into creatures of the night to pitch products on the Home Spooky Network.

episodes.title: Duets: It Takes Two
episodes.summary: Six new queens enter for Bracket 2 — and pair up to perform duets at the Sha-Blammy Awards. But will these musical matches make harmony or total chaos? Broadway star and pop icon Reneé Rapp joins the judges for this vocal showdown.

episodes.title: How-To Videos
episodes.summary: It's DIY drag as the queens direct their own over-the-top How-To videos. But with tensions simmering and alliances in flux, this challenge could get messy. Gina Gershon brings her signature smolder to the judges panel.

episodes.title: Too Many Daddies
episodes.summary: For the final Bracket 2 challenge, the queens make over real-life gay dads. But family ties get tested and shocking twists await in the MVQ Ceremony. Abbott Elementary's Janelle James lends her wit to the panel.

episodes.title: Athletic Supporter Design Challenge
episodes.summary: Bracket 3 begins as six new queens turn jockwear into glamazonian eleganza in a sporty design challenge. Who'll score on the runway? Guest judge Juno Temple brings her British charm - and sharp critiques - to the judges panel.

episodes.title: Rappin' Roast Redux
episodes.summary: Feelings get fried as the Bracket 3 queens spit spicy verses in a raucous Rappin' Roast. With shade flying and reps on the line, actor Brian Tyree Henry joins the judges panel to help decide who flowed and who flopped.

episodes.title: That's What She Said
episodes.summary: For the first time in Drag Race herstory, the queens lip sync to classic ‘90s interviews from The RuPaul Show. With the semifinals in sight, the MVQ ceremony serves up drama as The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City star Bronwyn Newport joins the judges panel.

episodes.title: Tell Me Something Good
episodes.summary: The Semifinalists return to face off – and the wildcard winner gags the Werkroom. Their first challenge: slay the "Tell Me Something Good" Story Hour, coached by guest judge comedian Evan Mulrooney. But a surprising twist leads to a startling elimination.

episodes.title: Tournament of All Stars Talent Rumble
episodes.summary: The top 7 queens put it all on the line in a no-holds-barred Tournament of All Stars Talent Rumble. With spots in the finale at stake, expect showstoppers, stunts, and surprises. Guest judge Cooper Koch helps decide whose star power reigns supreme.

episodes.title: Disco Smackdown for the Crown
episodes.summary: It all comes down to this! The final 6 All Stars go head-to-head and toe-to-toe in a Disco Smackdown! But only one queen will claim victory, a $200,000 cash prize, and the coveted spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame!
